description: This file contains unit tests for the CloseConnection command in the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies functionalities such as JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, immutability, and resource path correctness related to the CloseConnection command class.

classes.name: CloseConnectionTest
classes.description: Unit test class for CloseConnection command, testing JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, immutability, and resource path.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the hashCode() and equals() implementations of CloseConnection.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Confirms that CloseConnection instances are immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnectionId
methods.description: Tests that creating a CloseConnection with a null connection ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates that CloseConnection correctly deserializes from a known JSON object.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that a CloseConnection instance correctly serializes to JSON.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates that getResourcePath returns the correct resource path for the command.
